web.notifications.promise: Alerts arrive only while this page is open, your radio is connected and in range, and the weather radio is broadcasting. Closing the tab stops them. This is not a substitute for a NOAA weather radio or your phone's emergency alerts.
web.notifications.pageOnly: Notifications stop when this tab is closed.
web.notifications.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site, so a bell cannot ring. Allow them in your browser's site settings.
web.notifications.unsupported: This browser cannot show notifications, so a bell cannot ring.
